summary.text: Mark Sylvia is a Democratic state representative from Massachusetts who has represented the 10th Bristol District since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 1 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: Sylvia was born in New Bedford, Massachusetts, graduated from Fairhaven High School, and earned a bachelor's degree from American University in 1996 and a graduate degree from American University in 1998.
His career experience includes work in government administration and as a town manager, commissioner, undersecretary, and executive.
He took office in the Massachusetts House of Representatives on January 1, 2025, succeeding William Straus.

For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists him on the House Global Warming and Climate Change, House Federal Funding, Policy and Accountability, Environment, Natural Resources and Agriculture Joint, and Labor and Workforce Development Joint committees.
